defects.title: Post-freeze planView mutation reachable without downstream invalidation
defects.description: Stage 08 (hygiene/integrity) and Stage 09 (tiling) contain code paths that can mutate planView geometry after the declared horizontal-geometry freeze at stage_05_geometry. No fail-closed guard invalidates downstream stages if such mutation occurs.
defects.evidence: GEOMETRY_FREEZE_AUDIT.json shows post_freeze_mutations_reachable=true for ultimate_pipeline/pipeline_stages/stage_08_hygiene.py and stage_09_tiling.py
defects.reproduction: Search for planView/geometry mutation patterns in post-freeze stages; audit shows stage_08_hygiene and stage_09_tiling contain planView handling
defects.fix_required: Implement fail-closed guard: hash planView at freeze, verify before tiling/integrity, or move mutations to pre-freeze
